brand.name: Sagara Villas

brand.demoDisclosure: Portfolio demonstration project — fictional property, rates, and availability.

public.heroTitle: A Quiet Stay by the Coast.
public.heroSubtitle: Choose from our villa units, check the dates, and send a booking request. Our team confirms personally.
public.privacyConsent: By submitting, you agree that the information you provide is stored and used to respond to your request. This is a demo: submitting a request does not create a confirmed reservation.
public.requestSuccess: Request received. Your reference is {code}. This is not a confirmed reservation. Our team will contact you.

login.title: Sign in to Sagara Villas
login.subtitle: Enter your operational account credentials to manage reservations, availability, and manual payments.
login.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Please wait 15 minutes.
login.demoNotice: Portfolio demonstration environment — authorized staff accounts only.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Operational summary of arrivals, departures, pending requests, and balances in Asia/Makassar time.
dashboard.forbiddenNotice: Your account role (STAFF) does not have permission to access Administrator-only settings.
dashboard.recentReservationsSubtitle: Latest stays ordered by check-in date.
dashboard.emptyReservationsBody: New public booking requests and staff reservations will appear here.

sections.calendarSubtitle: Resource timeline of villa units, reservations by status, and maintenance blocks.
sections.reservationsSubtitle: Search, filter, confirm, check in, check out, and manage guest reservations.
sections.guestsSubtitle: Guest directory, contact history, and stay records.
sections.unitsSubtitle: Villa inventory, capacities, amenities, and demo nightly rates.
sections.reportsSubtitle: Reservations, manual payments, occupancy, and arrivals/departures with formula-safe CSV export.
sections.usersSubtitle: Administrator-only directory of operational accounts. Password hashes are never exposed.

reservationsPage.searchPlaceholder: Code, guest name, email, or phone…
reservationsPage.emptyTitle: No reservations match the current filters
reservationsPage.emptyDescription: Try clearing your search filters or create a new staff reservation.

reservationForm.pageSubtitle: Record a walk-in, phone, WhatsApp, or direct staff reservation. Prices are calculated and snapshotted on save.
reservationForm.guestHelper: Existing guests are matched automatically by normalized email or phone number (BR-15).

reservationDetail.checkInEarlyOverride: Allow early check-in before scheduled arrival date (audited)
reservationDetail.cancelDialogDescription: Cancelling releases the blocked unit dates immediately. Existing payments are preserved and flagged if a refund is due.
reservationDetail.noFurtherTransitions: This reservation is in a terminal status ({status}) with no further status transitions.
reservationDetail.versionConflictBody: This reservation was modified in another session. Reload the latest version before saving changes.
reservationDetail.editSectionSubtitle: Updating dates, unit, or discount re-validates availability and recalculates the snapshotted price.

paymentPanel.title: Manual Payments & Balance
paymentPanel.subtitle: Payment status is derived automatically from non-voided payments minus refunds (BR-09).
paymentPanel.overpaidWarningBody: Net payments exceed the reservation total by {amount}. Record a refund or verify the ledger entries.
paymentPanel.refundPendingBody: This cancelled reservation still has a positive net paid balance of {amount} (BR-11).
paymentPanel.voidDialogDescription: Payments are never deleted. Voiding strikes through the entry, records your reason in the audit log, and recomputes the reservation payment status.
paymentPanel.emptyPayments: No payments or refunds have been recorded for this reservation yet.

auditTrail.title: Audit Trail
auditTrail.subtitle: Immutable operational log of all reservation and payment actions.

guestsPage.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email, phone, or country…
guestsPage.emptyDescription: Guests are created automatically from booking requests or added manually by staff.

guestDetail.anonymizeDialogDescription: This permanently scrubs the guest's name, email, phone, country, and notes while preserving linked reservation and payment ledgers (DATABASE §11).
